The Altruists Rewrites the FTX Collapse as an Implausible Dangerous Liaisons for Nerds

In the four years since FTX collapsed —and the three since the cryptocurrency exchange’s founder, Sam Bankman-Fried , was convicted on multiple fraud charges —its downfall has been squeezed to fit many narrative frames. It’s the Emperor’s New Clothes or Icarus flying too close to the sun. Or maybe it’s a cautionary tale about Bankman-Fried’s guiding philosophy, effective altruism , which encourages adherents to maximize charitable giving by earning a lot of money. …
